reports.caption: Figure 1: Controlled diagnosis of program specialization. Both arms use 386 complete MATH tasks, nine slots, and three repeats. Headroom uses repeat means. Persistent tasks have at least one generated member winning/losing against baseline in all three repeats; the sole win is extraction-sensitive. D is clone-adjusted held-out repeat gain (95% bootstrap CI). Program drawings are schematic.
